Why Choose GigitekAI for Your Website?

AI Chat Integration

Embedded AI chatbots trained on your business data — available 24/7 to qualify leads and support customers.

Conversion Optimization

A/B testing, heat mapping, and user behavior analytics built-in to maximize ROI and reduce bounce rates.

Enterprise Security

Zero Trust architecture, SOC 2 compliance, and HIPAA/PCI-DSS ready infrastructure built in from day one.

Mobile-First Responsive

Pixel-perfect on every device. Optimized for Core Web Vitals and SEO performance out of the box.

Analytics & Lead Gen

Built-in conversion tracking, lead capture forms, and CRM integrations to turn visitors into clients.

Rapid Deployment

From concept to live website in days, not months. Agile development with continuous delivery.
